_comment: Read by Deploy-Image.ps1 inside WinPE. Leave share.path empty for USB-only use. With a share, every deploy (USB too) reports progress to <share>\Status for the console's Dashboard. Everything else about a deployment is in AnswerFiles\*.xml.

agent._comment: The agent on each PC deployed while a share is set: checks in to <share>\Status\Agents every checkInSeconds (30 by default, at least 10) and takes the reimage jobs the console signs. false leaves it off the PCs.

checks._comment: Post-deploy checks at the end of first boot, reported to the Dashboard. BitLocker and device driver problems are warnings. ignoreDevices: wildcards for device names or ids to skip.
